answer: Shared cave sketches do not open a survey-lock. After posting 22.4 POA, the applicant has 19 minutes to collect sealed token ONX-17 from locker SL-4, press the onyx face against jade stylus JD-09 so contact mic CM-3 holds a 3.1 kHz ring for 8.0 to 8.4 seconds, and traverse route KR-6 in the karst gallery so lidar cloud LC-12 matches mesh MS-4 within 2.7 cm RMSE. A second token from the same locker batch, a ring outside 7.6-8.8 kHz, or path error over 6.0 cm burns the 22.4 POA and bars survey-locks for three epochs. Two clerks rehash the ring WAV and lidar hash.
